analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported Q1 FY27 revenue from operations of ₹532 crore, representing a 35% year-on-year growth, and EBITDA of ₹89 crore. The company faced first-quarter operating challenges from elevated raw material prices, early monsoon deficits, and West Asia shipping disruptions. Management expects to achieve 30%-35% turnover growth over the previous year, supported by higher capacity utilization of its newly expanded NPK facility and projected quarterly revenue of over ₹500 crore for the remaining quarters of FY27. Krishana Phoschem Limited reported a 34.58% YoY growth in Q1 FY27 revenue to ₹532.3 crore and a 53.88% YoY increase in Profit After Tax to ₹47.06 crore. Management highlighted that expanded capacities at Meghnagar for NPK/DAP and Sulphuric Acid are contributing progressively to performance.

guidance.claim: Krishana Phoschem expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover growth over last year.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to generate a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: Utilization of the newly commissioned NPK capacity is expected to steadily ramp up in the coming quarters.
guidance.quote: The NPK capacity commission during the previous quarter is expected to witness a steady ramp-up in utilization over the coming quarters.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver growth of over 40% across key financial parameters in FY27.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: Management projects a top-line revenue increase of approximately Rs.500 crore from the newly expanded capacity.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect a top line increase of around Rs. 500 crore.

guidance.claim: Krishana Phoschem targets overall revenue growth of 35%-40% in FY27.
guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects to import around 150,000 metric tons of material in FY27, generating approximately Rs.1,000 crore in revenue.
guidance.quote: For FY27, based on market demand, we expect to import around 150,000 metric tons of material, which would translate into approximately Rs.1,000 crore of revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Rainfall improved in early July, leading to a recovery in sowing progress and accelerated fertilizer offtake.
demand_outlook.quote: However, rainfall improved materially during early July, resulting in a rapid recovery in sowing progress, improved farmer sentiment, and accelerated fertilizer offtake across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season.

demand_outlook.claim: Monsoon revival, higher MSPs, and government NBS subsidy support are expected to support fertilizer demand for the remainder of FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving in monsoon conditions, higher MSP and continued government support through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are expected to support the fertilizer demand during the remainder of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic fertilizer manufacturers are unlikely to experience demand pressure.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand dynamics remained stable during the Q4 FY26 Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: A favorable monsoon outlook supports a constructive demand environment for agriculture.
demand_outlook.quote: On one hand, a stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.

demand_outlook.claim: Fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable despite monsoon forecasts of 95% of normal.
demand_outlook.quote: Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

capex_expansion.claim: Krishana Phoschem is evaluating capacity expansion proposals that await Board approval and statutory disclosures.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities. Since these have not yet been approved or disclosed through the statutory channels, we are not in a position to share details at this stage.

capex_expansion.claim: The company signed an agreement to purchase green ammonia from a third-party capacity arrangement with the government.
capex_expansion.quote: See this capacity of green ammonia is of a third-party capacity and we will buy this green ammonia with an arrangement from the Government of India, Department of Fertilizer one thing.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar for NPK/DAP and Sulphuric Acid are contributing progressively to performance.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its NPK/DAP capacity by 50% to 495,000 MTPA, raising total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened by adding 99,000 MTPA of sulphuric acid capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion was funded through internal accruals and term loans.
capex_expansion.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capex_expansion.claim: Management currently has no additional capital expansion plans beyond the completed projects.
capex_expansion.quote: No, so far, we have not planned anything. Whatever we have, it has been implemented.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA reached ₹89 crore, registering a 36% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: Quarterly EBITDA stood at ₹ 89 crore, reflecting a 36% year-on-year growth, supported by disciplined cost management, despite volatility in raw material prices.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins stand at approximately 7%–8% for trading operations and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company passed on approximately 25%–30% of raw material cost increases through subsidy support and revised selling prices.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs. This has been achieved through a combination of higher subsidy support and revisions in MRPs.

margins_costs.claim: Sulphur prices increased from ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
margins_costs.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 PAT grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore due to improved operating efficiency and cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Global input costs increased from mid-February onwards due to supply constraints and higher freight rates.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability is expected to moderate slightly in FY27 as the company absorbs a portion of input cost increases.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, of course, we will absorb to some extent and as a result, our profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27.

margins_costs.claim: The company's trading business operates at an EBITDA margin of 5% to 6%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin is 5% to 6% in in trading business.

margins_costs.claim: Manufacturing EBITDA per ton was in the range of Rs.5,500 per ton in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: It was in the range of Rs.5,500 per ton.

margins_costs.claim: For SSP, EBITDA per ton is expected to remain around Rs.1,500 to Rs.1,600.
margins_costs.quote: For SSP, that range should broadly hold.

orders_capacity.claim: Fertilizer production reached 89,747 metric tonnes during Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Q1 FY27 capacity utilization stood at 43% for the NPK-DAP unit and 121% for the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Total NPK-DAP capacity expanded to 495,000 MT following the addition of 165,000 MT capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

orders_capacity.claim: Q1 FY27 sales volumes were 53,500 MT for NPK-DAP, 36,300 MT for SSP, and 21,000 MT for trading.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK-DAP, it was 53,500 MT, for SSP 36,300 MT

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed manufacturing capacity of 6.15 Lakh MTPA.
Fertilizer production reached 94,103 MT in Q4 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production for FY26 reached 397,263 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: Current utilization of the 200,000-ton rock phosphate beneficiation capacity ranges between 50% and 75%.
orders_capacity.quote: The beneficiation capacity is around 200,000 tons, and current utilization is in the range of 50% to 75%.

orders_capacity.claim: In FY26, manufacturing volume stood at around 383,000 metric tons and trading volume at approximately 93,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.

capital_allocation.claim: The company executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of equity shares from ₹10 to ₹2.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Depreciation increased to ₹13 crore and finance costs rose to ₹20 crore following the commissioning of new capacity.
capital_allocation.quote: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, while finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: Q1 collection of receivables exceeded ₹700 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Collection is more than Rs. 700 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: Disciplined capital allocation is one of the five core pillars of the company's strategic blueprint.
capital_allocation.quote: Our strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars: backward integration, capacity expansion, product diversification, disciplined capital allocation and deep farmer connect.

capital_allocation.claim: CRISIL upgraded Krishana Phoschem's credit rating to A+ (Stable).
capital_allocation.quote: We are also pleased to highlight that our credit rating has been upgraded by CRISIL to A+ (Stable), reflecting improved financial strength and business fundamentals

capital_allocation.claim: Effective interest cost across facilities ranges between 6% and 7.5%.
capital_allocation.quote: Overall, the effective interest cost is in the range of 6% to 7.5%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflicts surrounding the Strait of Hormuz caused shipping route uncertainties, higher freight costs, and raw material procurement inflation.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Cumulative rainfall by late June was nearly 40% below normal, causing national Kharif sowing to fall by 22.7% year-on-year.
risks_headwinds.quote: By the end of June, cumulative rainfall was nearly 40% below normal, resulting in national Kharif sowing declining by 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares, compared to 236.5 lakh hectares during the corresponding period last year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Industry-wide fertilizer production fell 28% year-on-year in April-May 2026 due to raw material and logistics constraints.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the April-May 2026 period, industry-wide production declined by 28% year-on-year, while SSP production dropped by around 7% year-on-year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heavy reliance on imported intermediates exposes the cost structure directly to global price movements.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

risks_headwinds.claim: First-quarter margins are expected to face pressure due to higher input costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: While there may be some margin pressure in the first quarter, we expect margins to stabilize in the later part of the year as cost increases are passed on.

management_commitments.claim: Krishana Phoschem expects to deliver 30% to 35% turnover growth over the previous year.
management_commitments.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve quarterly turnover exceeding ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of the fiscal year.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

management_commitments.claim: The contracted green ammonia capacity supply is set to start in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to build on financial and operational momentum through the remainder of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident of building on this momentum through the remainder of FY27, as we continue strengthening India's agri-future for our farmers, partners, & shareholders

management_commitments.claim: Management expects capacity expansion benefits to meaningfully reflect in operational performance from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to deliver over 40% growth across key metrics during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets overall revenue growth of 35%-40% in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
